note: The compiled core's MEMBERSHIP, frozen at commit 7ae1d540 (7,247 entries): [headword, class, clf, entry number]. The analyser reads the core alone when no shard is loaded, so an entry that leaves it changes a reading; the build puts exactly these entries in the core, whatever their glosses cost in bytes, and fails when one no longer exists in the lexicon (--accept-core-drops after a decision). Add an entry here on purpose, never by a byte budget.
